source: Chetty & Hendren (2018), Online Data Table II (county causal place effects) and Table IV (county population 2000), opportunityinsights.org
measure: Percentage gain in household income at age 26 per year of childhood spent in the place, relative to the national mean, for children of parents at the 25th (p25) and 75th (p75) income percentiles. State values are county estimates weighted by 2000 population.
